facts.text: DroneNavigation-v0 is registered with id 'DroneNavigation-v0' and entry point 'drone_envs.envs:DroneNavigationV0'
The action space is a 3-element Box with low [-0.1, -0.1, -0.1] and high [0.1, 0.1, 0.1]
The observation space is 9 elements: drone x and y in [-12, 12], z in [0, 12], each velocity in [-3, 3], goal x and y in [-9, 9] and goal z in [0, 9]
A step applies the action, advances the pybullet simulation, reads the drone observation and returns the observation concatenated with the goal, the reward, done and reach_target
The simulation timestep is set to 1/30 s
Each thrust component is clipped to [-0.1, 0.1] and applied as an external force to link 4 in the link frame
The drone is loaded at base position [0, 0, 0.1]
The drone base link mass is 0.027 kg
The drone observation is the base position followed by the base linear velocity
A reset resets the simulation, reloads the plane and drone, draws a new goal and returns the initial observation
The goal is drawn with x and y uniform in [5, 9] or [-9, -5] and z uniform in [5, 9]
The reward is the decrease in distance to the goal; leaving x or y at +-12 or z at or below 0 or at or above 12 subtracts 1 and ends the episode, and a distance below 2 adds 50 and sets reach_target
seed() reseeds the environment random generator from gym.utils.seeding.np_random and returns the seed
The upstream run script creates the environment with gym.make(env_name)
The project is a PyBullet and OpenAI Gym environment

determinism.notes: the goal draw comes from the environment generator seeded by seed(); the kinematic update has no randomness, so one seed and one action sequence give the same observations in this package's fake, while the upstream pybullet model is not modelled and was not compared

gaps: the checked fake is a kinematic point-mass stand-in: no rigid-body orientation, gravity, contacts, drag, actuator, sensor or noise model; it does not reproduce the upstream pybullet model (README.md:3)

the fake advances velocity and position with dt = 1/30 s from the base link mass 0.027 kg and ignores the plane, the goal body and collisions, so its trajectories differ from the upstream simulator and were never compared with it
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and only cap.world.step.v1 advances simulated time
DroneNavigation-v1 (the 16 x 16 camera and the 30 obstacle cubes) and rendering are not modelled; this package covers DroneNavigation-v0 only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
